title: Verify distinct claims with the smallest useful checks
when: A reversible edit needs verification and the user wants minimum repetition.
do: Run package/reference/coverage checks once for new bytes.
Run one native render for changed layout/glyph behavior; inspect changed regions and page distribution.
Run scratch copy/edit only for the newly required behavior.
Repeat only after a defect or change invalidates prior evidence.
check: Source fidelity, math validity, rendering, editability and acceptance remain separate result fields.
limitation: HeadCtrl/Next counts may omit nested controls; use package XML for complete containment.
